parts.name: wall_mount
parts.motion_note: Fixed to the wall; mirror the entire assembly for the opposite firing direction.

parts.name: spring_ram
parts.motion_note: Compress on front contact for 0.1 s, launch character outward, then return; only front-side trigger has impulse.

parts.name: ceiling_mount
parts.motion_note: Fixed upper housing.

parts.name: mortar
parts.motion_note: Fixed lower bowl. Hazard swept volume lies between the two separate parts.

parts.name: pestle
parts.motion_note: Approach triggers warning for at least 0.7 s; piston descends, pauses, ascends. Enable crush hazard only on descent.

parts.name: pedestal
parts.motion_note: Stays fixed beneath the slowing dough.

parts.name: dough
parts.motion_note: Compress while stood upon; horizontal ground speed is reduced, restored immediately on leaving.

parts.name: half_block
parts.motion_note: Choose lower or upper variant in authoring; exactly one 16px half of a 32px cell is solid, with box collider matched to the filled half.

parts.name: platform
parts.motion_note: One-way top only. Down swipe disables only the connected platform group beneath the character until completely clear.

parts.name: drop_indicator
parts.motion_note: Brief indicator on down swipe; does not affect collision.

parts.name: track
parts.motion_note: Track is fixed to the level and can repeat in 32px pieces along the route; never move with the cart.

parts.name: cart
parts.motion_note: Translate the cart child along the route from boarding to destination. At destination when empty, vanish. Reappear in a clear start zone via respawn_0→respawn_1→respawn_2→idle; solid only at idle.

parts.name: wheels
parts.motion_note: Parent to the cart, rotate/flip 2-frame hubs during travel; hide with cart while vanished, enable when solid.

parts.name: lanterns
parts.motion_note: Hanging lights and suspension remain after the collision ledge vanishes.

parts.name: light_bridge
parts.motion_note: One-way support. On exit, warn ≥0.7s, fade and disable collider, then relight only when clear.

parts.name: base
parts.motion_note: Fixed beam, central fulcrum, and support. Neither moving tray is baked into it.

parts.name: left_plate
parts.motion_note: When boarded on left: down by 12px; when boarded on right: up by 11px. Update one-way collider with plate. If both occupied, hold.

parts.name: right_plate
parts.motion_note: Right rises when left descends and vice versa; separately animated top collider.

parts.name: bowl
parts.motion_note: Jade bowl and rim hold one-way top.

parts.name: moon_liquid
parts.motion_note: Glow fills on landing; one subsequent jump gets vertical boost, then liquid dims. Follow run-state reset.

parts.name: mount
parts.motion_note: Anchor remains fixed at the level ceiling.

parts.name: pendulum
parts.motion_note: Decorative no-collision jade bob; swing synchronized to ride plate world translation. Entire route arc is reserved externally.

parts.name: ride_plate
parts.motion_note: Top one-way collider travels along pendulum route. Slight local bounce here; full lateral movement is code-owned.

parts.name: roof_rail
parts.motion_note: Fixed guide rail continues over the full slide distance.

parts.name: sliding_roof
parts.motion_note: On boarding, roof translates right (preview uses +24px local travel). It stops while empty, then returns only when path is unoccupied. Move rider with roof.

parts.name: moon_dial
parts.motion_note: Static phase indicator and activation focus; no collision.

parts.name: stair_1
parts.motion_note: Individual one-way stair child. Toggle A↔B on glyph contact. Delay removal or form swap while occupied; each child's collider follows the child.

parts.name: stair_2
parts.motion_note: Individual one-way stair child. Toggle A↔B on glyph contact. Delay removal or form swap while occupied; each child's collider follows the child.

parts.name: stair_3
parts.motion_note: Individual one-way stair child. Toggle A↔B on glyph contact. Delay removal or form swap while occupied; each child's collider follows the child.

parts.name: whale_body
parts.motion_note: Whale travels along its own authored route with the rider; departs only on boarding, waits at terminus, returns physically when empty. Body/front has no solid collision.

parts.name: dorsal_deck
parts.motion_note: Child of whale body world transform. Its horizontal crown is the one-way rider support; collider follows whale motion.

parts.name: tail_fin
parts.motion_note: Child of whale body transform; fin flexes locally without collision.

parts.name: cotton_platform
parts.motion_note: One-way top supports until the player leaves; show 0.7 s deformation warning, then disable support while dispersed and restore after cooldown.

parts.name: breath_vent
parts.motion_note: Decorative fixed cloud outlet; non-solid.

parts.name: air_stream
parts.motion_note: Wind trigger volume supplies upward acceleration and caps rise height; streamline animation translates upward; no physical collider.

parts.name: hanging_bracket
parts.motion_note: Fixed hanging bracket and suspension; does not collide.

parts.name: bell_shell
parts.motion_note: Contact trigger calls linked transport once, swings then waits for reuse cooldown; bell/front has trigger collision only.

parts.name: balloon_envelope
parts.motion_note: Child of lift root. Envelope is non-solid; world Y movement happens in gameplay on rider boarding and empty ascent.

parts.name: rigging
parts.motion_note: Ropes are a separate non-colliding child bound to lift root; not baked into envelope or basket.

parts.name: passenger_deck
parts.motion_note: One-way basket top supplies rider support and follows world-space lift root. Keep the ropes anchored to the deck while translating.

parts.name: fixed_mast
parts.motion_note: Stationary rear support; rotor rotates independently in front.

parts.name: blade_north
parts.motion_note: Individually rideable one-way blade. Collider rotates around (48,48) source pixels at 8 evenly spaced angles; rider follows angular orbit. Start phase 0/8.

parts.name: blade_east
parts.motion_note: Individually rideable one-way blade. Collider rotates around (48,48) source pixels at 8 evenly spaced angles; rider follows angular orbit. Start phase 2/8.

parts.name: blade_south
parts.motion_note: Individually rideable one-way blade. Collider rotates around (48,48) source pixels at 8 evenly spaced angles; rider follows angular orbit. Start phase 4/8.

parts.name: blade_west
parts.motion_note: Individually rideable one-way blade. Collider rotates around (48,48) source pixels at 8 evenly spaced angles; rider follows angular orbit. Start phase 6/8.

parts.name: center_hub
parts.motion_note: Fixed drawing over the blade roots; center is decoration and non-colliding.

parts.name: rainbow_slope
parts.motion_note: Fixed downhill top is the support curve; gives downhill tangent acceleration, permits jumping and weak opposing input braking.

parts.name: direction_flow
parts.motion_note: Small aligned chevrons run along the ramp to show downhill direction; visuals only, with no extra collision.

parts.name: umbrella_pole
parts.motion_note: Fixed authored root marker and umbrella handle, non-solid.

parts.name: canopy
parts.motion_note: Enable one-way top collision only for fully open umbrella. 0.7 s regional-rain warning precedes opening; delay closing while occupied.

parts.name: rain_cue
parts.motion_note: Purposeful regional rain warning beside the canopy; cue follows area weather, not contact.

parts.name: fixed_rail
parts.motion_note: Rail remains in world at its start emplacement; extend path with standard rail segments, never parent it under moving deck.

parts.name: passenger_deck
parts.motion_note: One-way top supports passengers; translate along route after wind warning ≥0.7 s, pause at end, return physically on empty. Wheels animate intrinsically.

parts.name: mast_sail
parts.motion_note: Sail and mast are a separate decorative child under moving deck root; unfurls with local wind. No sail collision.

parts.name: lectern
parts.motion_note: Fixed book hinge and stand.

parts.name: pages
parts.motion_note: Page top is one-way only while open; hold closing until all occupants leave.

parts.name: shaft
parts.motion_note: Track and housing remain fixed; long shaft uses repeated segment tiles in the level.

parts.name: lift
parts.motion_note: Elevator ride path and collider position are driven by Unity; these frames preview the departure and dock within this 2x2 canvas.

parts.name: counterweight
parts.motion_note: Counterweight travels opposite the lift along its own guide; decorative and noncolliding.

parts.name: basin
parts.motion_note: Surface contact uses the underlying ground collider.

parts.name: ink
parts.motion_note: Animate fluid ripples on foot contact; slow effect clears immediately when feet leave.

parts.name: cabinet
parts.motion_note: Cabinet collision stays fixed.

parts.name: drawer
parts.motion_note: Drawer root moves horizontally toward the clear front side; its one-way top collider must follow and retract only when unoccupied.

parts.name: frame
parts.motion_note: Fixed mechanical housing and end rollers.

parts.name: belt
parts.motion_note: Phase-shift type arrows rightward and add one-way contact velocity; no grounded input lock.

parts.name: book_base
parts.motion_note: The hinged cover and spine stay in place.

parts.name: step_1
parts.motion_note: Individual step 1 rises in order and owns only its top one-way collider; hold fold while occupied.

parts.name: step_2
parts.motion_note: Individual step 2 rises in order and owns only its top one-way collider; hold fold while occupied.

parts.name: step_3
parts.motion_note: Individual step 3 rises in order and owns only its top one-way collider; hold fold while occupied.

parts.name: track
parts.motion_note: Rail/stop architecture remains fixed; level code handles long horizontal route.

parts.name: stop_plate
parts.motion_note: Book-spine platform travels while empty, stops at its current path coordinate instantly when occupied, then resumes on exit.

parts.name: shelf_base
parts.motion_note: Static shelves, book rows, and central hinge remain fixed.

parts.name: left_branch
parts.motion_note: Only the left connector rises after dwell selection; branch collision follows this separate plate.

parts.name: right_branch
parts.motion_note: Only the right connector rises after dwell selection; branch collision follows this separate plate.

parts.name: selector
parts.motion_note: Selector handle rotates toward the chosen connection only after the left/right dwell condition is met.

parts.name: glass_planters
parts.motion_note: Three 32-pixel grid planters remain fixed; each sprout owns its own leaves and stem.

parts.name: sprout_1
parts.motion_note: Plant 1 grows after plant 0; enable one-way leaf-top collider only when this plant reaches full and no actor overlaps.

parts.name: sprout_2
parts.motion_note: Plant 2 grows after plant 1; enable one-way leaf-top collider only when this plant reaches full and no actor overlaps.

parts.name: sprout_3
parts.motion_note: Plant 3 grows after plant 2; enable one-way leaf-top collider only when this plant reaches full and no actor overlaps.

parts.name: vine_shaft
parts.motion_note: Fixed side vines, glass runners, top/bottom stops. No tray pixels.

parts.name: lift_tray
parts.motion_note: Move this leaf tray along its authored vertical path with collider and passengers; these are in-place leaf-flex frames. Static vine shaft stays at the root.

parts.name: ceiling_mount
parts.motion_note: Fixed mount stays when glass hourglass falls.

parts.name: falling_hourglass
parts.motion_note: After a minimum 0.7 s warning move the hazard through the vertical path; impact shards are visual, not an additional collider.

parts.name: ground_warning
parts.motion_note: Ground projection marks the impact zone; keep warning art on a ground sorting layer.

parts.name: stem
parts.motion_note: Stem anchors are fixed under the deforming petals.

parts.name: spring_petals
parts.motion_note: One-way collision top tracks petals. Launch assist occurs on the next jump input, never automatically on first touch.

parts.name: glass_anchors
parts.motion_note: The two permanent banks and under-bridge glass guide remain static.

parts.name: dew_bridge
parts.motion_note: Enable one-way top only in solid state after overlap check; do not melt while occupied.

parts.name: sundial_pedestal
parts.motion_note: Fixed sundial stem, gold pivot, and triangular base.

parts.name: tilting_petals
parts.motion_note: Only petals tilt around the fixed pivot; update sloped top collider in safe, occupancy-preserving steps after the 0.7 s light warning.

parts.name: hourglass_route_base
parts.motion_note: Hourglass and route housing remain fixed; the rewind deck is independent.

parts.name: rewind_deck
parts.motion_note: Empty deck follows authored route forward; boarding reverses only deck trajectory. Move its root transform with passenger; player/world time do not rewind.

parts.name: vine_roots
parts.motion_note: Permanent roots at each bank; no bridge canopy baked into them.

parts.name: knot_bridge
parts.motion_note: Bridge grows across the gap; only a completed, overlap-checked deck has one-way collision. Locked state persists through checkpoint for the run.

parts.name: plinth
parts.motion_note: Fixed faceted crystal socket; central crystal and resonance ring are separate.

parts.name: central_crystal
parts.motion_note: Central top stays on its gameplay collider; light adjacent authored crystals one at a time.

parts.name: resonance_ring
parts.motion_note: Noncolliding angular light ring. No crystal body pixels in this part.

parts.name: housing
parts.motion_note: Fixed spring socket. Mirror the assembled object for left or right launch orientation.

parts.name: refractive_head
parts.motion_note: Full body collision faces the indicated launch side; apply horizontal launch and small upward assist at release.

parts.name: ceiling_mount
parts.motion_note: Ceiling attachment is independent of the falling stalactite.

parts.name: falling_stalactite
parts.motion_note: Object drops after minimum 0.7 s warning and re-arms only when approach zone is empty. Game hazard follows crystal, not the mount.

parts.name: ground_warning
parts.motion_note: Noncolliding ground projection warns of impact.

parts.name: magnetic_track
parts.motion_note: Fixed route, endpoint stops, and noncolliding zigzag magnet connector. Neither plate is baked into track.

parts.name: left_plate
parts.motion_note: Left plate has its own one-way top and transform. Keep the occupied plate fixed; move only the unoccupied partner to its authored end, then return when both are empty.

parts.name: right_plate
parts.motion_note: Right plate has its own one-way top and transform. Keep the occupied plate fixed; move only the unoccupied partner to its authored end, then return when both are empty.

parts.name: polished_slab
parts.motion_note: Stable one-way surface. Friction and walking deceleration are gameplay parameters, not sprite displacement.

parts.name: surface_reflection
parts.motion_note: Surface light streak slides across the fixed slab; no collision change. Set medium horizontal inertia but allow walking input to brake.

parts.name: prism_anchors
parts.motion_note: Two permanent prism pillars and lower guide; bridge pixels excluded.

parts.name: light_bridge
parts.motion_note: Bridge one-way collider exists only in solid state after overlap check; occupancy postpones dissolve.

parts.name: fixed_support
parts.motion_note: Fixed floor runners and lever pivot housing. Shelf and lever handle are separate child sprites.

parts.name: lever_handle
parts.motion_note: Move handle around fixed pivot on player touch; latch persists through checkpoint for current run.

parts.name: sliding_shelf
parts.motion_note: Shelf moves exactly one 32-pixel world cell after validating origin, path and endpoint clearance. Child one-way collider follows shelf; no player push.

parts.name: branching_track
parts.motion_note: Fixed left/right branching tracks and stoppers; export independently of the cart and switch.

parts.name: branch_switch
parts.motion_note: Switch moves separately at the rail junction; only a stable left/right standing choice at a stopped cart selects route.

parts.name: cart
parts.motion_note: Cart deck/seat and wheels only. Translate this child along selected world route with passenger and deck collider; never translate the branching_track. Export CART separately from TRACK.
